title: Reviews per reviewer
statementMd:
How many reviews did each reviewer write?

Expected columns: `reviewer`, `reviews`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT reviewer, COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM reviews GROUP BY reviewer;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
